hpe_engine_relayout.brief: 重建盒树并重新夹紧滚动偏移 / Rebuild the box tree and re-clamp the scroll offset
hpe_engine_relayout.note: 急切入口：无条件全量重建；实现位于 `hope.c`；加载、缩放、悬停、定时器等路径使用，惰性策略在 `hpe_engine_flush` / The eager entry point: unconditionally rebuilds everything; implemented in `hope.c`; used by load, resize, hover and timer paths, while the lazy policy lives in `hpe_engine_flush`

hpe_engine_flush.brief: 应用自上次以来记录的 DOM 变更，只做其所需的排版/重绘 / Apply the DOM mutations recorded since the last call, doing only as much layout/repaint as they require

params.engine: 引擎实例，NULL 时直接返回 / Engine instance, returns early when NULL
params.force: 非零请求全量重建 / Non-zero requests a full rebuild

hpe_engine_flush.details: 惰性重排策略：LAYOUT 重建受影响的盒子子树（作用域无界时整树）；PAINT 重算样式并重绘；NONE 完全跳过。作用域由变更汇聚点记录，可把重建限制在局部子树。| Lazy policy: LAYOUT rebuilds the affected box subtree (everything when unbounded), PAINT recomputes styles and repaints, and NONE skips entirely. The scope is recorded by the mutation sink, which can bound the rebuild to a partial subtree.

hpe_engine_refresh_status.brief: 刷新状态行文本 / Refresh the status line
hpe_engine_refresh_status.note: 实现位于 `hope.c`；汇总文件名、尺寸、是否含地址栏、加载/绘制耗时与滚动位置，并追加粘性加载错误 / Implemented in `hope.c`; formats the file name, size, chrome flag, load/paint timings and scroll position, and appends the sticky load error

hpe_engine_view_height.brief: 取页面视口高度（窗口高减地址栏）/ Get the page viewport height (window height minus chrome)
hpe_engine_view_height.return: 视口高度（像素），不小于 0；`engine` 为 NULL 时返回 0 / Viewport height in pixels, never below 0; 0 when `engine` is NULL

hpe_chrome_set_text.brief: 替换地址栏文本并把插入符移到末尾 / Replace the address-bar text and put the caret at the end

params.text: 新文本，超长时按输入框容量截断 / New text, truncated to the field capacity when too long

hpe_chrome_set_text.note: 选区折叠，并记录为 Escape 回退所用的地址；实现位于 `hope_chrome.c` / The selection is collapsed and the text is recorded as the address Escape falls back to; implemented in `hope_chrome.c`

hpe_chrome_paint.brief: 把地址栏绘制到顶部 `chrome_h` 像素 / Paint the address bar into the top `chrome_h` pixels
hpe_chrome_paint.note: 实现位于 `hope_chrome.c`；由 `hpe_engine_render` 在整帧或仅地址栏脏时调用 / Implemented in `hope_chrome.c`; called by `hpe_engine_render` for a full frame or a chrome-only repaint

hpe_chrome_mouse.brief: 处理地址栏条带内的一次指针按下 / 抬起 / Handle one pointer press/release inside the chrome strip

params.x: X 坐标（设备坐标）/ X coordinate in device coordinates
params.y: Y 坐标（设备坐标）/ Y coordinate in device coordinates
params.down: 按下为 1、抬起为 0 / 1 when pressed, 0 when released
params.mods: 修饰键掩码，`HPE_MOD_SHIFT` 时 Shift+点击扩展选区 / Modifier mask; `HPE_MOD_SHIFT` makes a Shift+click extend the selection

hpe_chrome_mouse.return: 事件被地址栏消费返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when the bar consumed the event, otherwise 0

hpe_chrome_mouse_move.brief: 地址栏拖选进行中时处理指针移动 / Handle a pointer move while the field is being dragged

params.x: X 坐标（设备坐标）/ X coordinate in device coordinates
params.y: Y 坐标（设备坐标）/ Y coordinate in device coordinates

hpe_chrome_mouse_move.return: 事件被地址栏消费返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when the bar consumed the event, otherwise 0
hpe_chrome_mouse_move.note: 实现位于 `hope_chrome.c`；即使指针离开条带，源自条带内的拖拽仍继续接收移动 / Implemented in `hope_chrome.c`; a drag that began inside the strip keeps receiving moves even once the pointer leaves it

hpe_chrome_navigate.brief: 按地址栏内容（`addr`）导航 / Navigate using the address-bar contents (`addr`)
hpe_chrome_navigate.return: 加载成功返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when the load succeeded, otherwise 0
hpe_chrome_navigate.note: 实现位于 `hope_chrome.c`；文本为空时重新加载内置空白页 / Implemented in `hope_chrome.c`; empty text reloads the built-in blank page
